articles.title: A multicenter, prospective, phase 2 trial on proton re-irradiation for patients with previously treated head and neck cancer
articles.summary: This phase 2 trial evaluates the effectiveness and safety of proton re-irradiation for patients with previously treated head and neck cancer. While the study demonstrates encouraging locoregional control and survival, it highlights the importance of monitoring late toxicities in heavily pretreated populations.

articles.title: AAPM Medical Physics Practice Guideline 18.a: Superficial radiation therapy using low-energy kilovoltage x-rays
articles.summary: The AAPM has released comprehensive practice guidelines for superficial radiation therapy (SRT) using low-energy kilovoltage x-rays. This report provides technical overviews and establishes minimum standards for SRT delivery in dermatology and radiation oncology clinical settings.

articles.title: A Large Language Model Framework for Seed Implant Brachytherapy: Adaptive Weight Optimization via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.summary: Researchers propose an adaptive weight optimization framework for seed implant brachytherapy planning using a locally deployed large language model. By integrating the LLM with an automatic planning algorithm, the study aims to improve plan quality and efficiency by automating manual adjustments of objective function weights.

articles.title: Analysis on radiation protection of FLASH treatment in conventional proton therapy facilities
articles.summary: This study demonstrates that existing conventional shielding for the Varian ProBeam system is sufficient for FLASH irradiation, ensuring radiation safety for staff and the surrounding environment. The findings provide a justification for implementing FLASH techniques in current proton therapy clinical settings.

articles.title: A cell-type resolved proton RBE model for potential clinical application
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a cell-type resolved RBE model that accounts for variations in cellular repair capabilities. This model shows strong agreement with experimental data, offering a more precise approach to RBE determination for clinical proton therapy.

articles.title: Differentiable Autoplanning Algorithm for Proton Therapy Based on Deep Learning: A Proof-of-Concept
articles.summary: This study introduces a deep learning framework capable of joint, gradient-based optimization of proton therapy beam parameters. The methodology lays the groundwork for next-generation automated treatment planning systems with clinical potential.

articles.title: Angle-Dependent Dose Transformer Algorithm for Fast Proton Therapy Dose Calculations
articles.summary: The researchers developed a beamlet angle-aware deep learning algorithm that provides Monte Carlo-level accuracy for proton dose calculations. This approach significantly improves calculation speed while maintaining precision, particularly for thoracic treatment plans.

articles.title: Experimental validation of time-driven proton PBS FLASH delivery on a clinical proton therapy system
articles.summary: This study validates a time-driven delivery method for proton PBS at ultra-high dose rates. The approach allows for reproducible dosimetry suitable for both clinical and preclinical radiobiological research on FLASH effects.

articles.title: Radiation therapy quality assurance (RT QA) of adjuvant fractionated radiotherapy for WHO grade 2 atypical meningioma in the ROAM/EORTC1308 trial
articles.summary: This study underscores the critical importance of prospective independent central reviews (ICRs) to ensure high-quality and consistent radiotherapy delivery across clinical sites for complex tumors. The researchers conclude that pre-trial QA alone is insufficient for robust trial outcomes in uncommon tumor cohorts.

articles.title: Artificial intelligence in image-guided cervical interventional radiotherapy: a systematic review
articles.summary: This systematic review explores the current landscape of AI applications in image-guided cervical brachytherapy. The authors emphasize that while AI shows promise for workflow automation, further clinical validation is necessary before integration into standard practice.

articles.title: Analysis on radiation protection of FLASH treatment in conventional proton therapy facilities
articles.summary: This study assesses radiation safety for FLASH proton therapy using the Varian ProBeam system within existing conventional shielding. The results demonstrate that occupational and environmental radiation doses remain within safe limits, supporting the potential clinical implementation of FLASH technology in standard facilities.

articles.title: A cell-type resolved proton RBE model for potential clinical application
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a cell-type resolved relative biological effectiveness (RBE) model for proton therapy. The model identifies that variations in cell repair capacity significantly influence RBE and demonstrates strong alignment with experimental data for clinical consideration.

articles.title: 50 million Americans live in counties without a radiation oncology clinic, study finds
articles.summary: A recent study highlights that 50 million Americans reside in counties lacking a radiation oncology clinic, underscoring significant geographic disparities in access to cancer treatment. This data provides professional context regarding the current landscape of radiation therapy distribution across the United States.

articles.title: ASTRO updates guideline on shorter-course radiation therapy for localized prostate cancer
articles.summary: The American Society for Radiation Oncology has issued an updated clinical guideline regarding the use of shorter-course radiation therapy for the treatment of localized prostate cancer. This update provides clinicians with current standards for optimizing treatment regimens.

articles.title: IBA treats first patient in clinical trial of FLASH proton therapy
articles.summary: IBA has successfully treated the first patient in a clinical trial evaluating ConformalFLASH proton therapy for head and neck cancer. This milestone marks a significant step in the clinical development and assessment of ultra-high dose rate radiation delivery.

articles.title: Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute opens new wellness space for patients and caregivers
articles.summary: The Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute has inaugurated a new wellness space designed to support patients and caregivers throughout their treatment journey. This development reflects the regional growth and commitment to patient-centered care within the DMV area.

articles.title: First Patient Treated in the C-FLASH-01 ConformalFLASH® Clinical Trial
articles.summary: A patient has been treated in the C-FLASH-01 trial investigating ConformalFLASH® proton therapy for head and neck cancer. This represents a significant milestone in advancing ultra-high dose rate radiation clinical research.

articles.title: BayCare opens proton therapy center at Tampa's St. Joseph’s Hospital
articles.summary: BayCare has officially opened a $33 million proton therapy center at St. Joseph’s Hospital in Tampa. The new facility expands access to advanced radiation technology in the region.
